208.task: A player idea: after a kill milestone (for example 100 kills) a wizard unlocks a small companion, such as a little dragon, that follows them, pulls enemy shots toward itself, has its own health, and disappears at 0 health. Nothing like it exists yet (no summons, no taunt or aggro targeting for enemies). It needs a per-player pet that takes player index 0-3, an enemy targeting rule that can prefer it, a health bar, and a say in how a kill-count unlock fits with runs and progression (M3 run structure and M5 meta-progression). It must not make co-op worse: with four players there could be four pets, so shot and particle budgets must hold. It must also fit DESIGN.md's focus on building spells; one option is to make the pet a spell form or relic rather than a separate system. Done when the weekly planning has weighed it against the M3 and M5 designs and either scheduled it or declined it with a reason. Not for M2.
